api:
<HeikinAshi data={bars} x={|b: &Bar| b.time}
    open={|b: &Bar| b.open} high={|b: &Bar| b.high} low={|b: &Bar| b.low}
    close={|b: &Bar| b.close} volume={|b: &Bar| b.volume} />
PropTypeDefault
dataVec<T>, Signal<Vec<T>>, or your own Datasetrequired
xFn(&T) -> f64: the start of each period, in milliseconds since the epochrequired
open, high, low, closeFn(&T) -> f64required
volumeFn(&T) -> f64none
modeCandleModeCandlesVolume
candle_styleCandleStyleCandles
up, downcoloursyour theme's good and bad colours
x_axisAxisConfiga time axis
y_axisAxisConfigAxisConfig::new()
legend, tooltip, classas on <Candlestick>

Each candle is averaged with the one before it:

PartFormula
close(open + high + low + close) / 4
open(previous open + previous close) / 2; the first candle uses (open + close) / 2
highthe largest of high, open and close
lowthe smallest of low, open and close

examples.title: Smoothed trend
examples.description: A rising market: Heikin-Ashi candles stay one colour while the trend lasts.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn trend_days() {
    let data = use_signal(bars(80, 1, 0.08));
    rsx! {
        <HeikinAshi data={data} x={|b: &Bar| b.time} open={|b: &Bar| b.open} high={|b: &Bar| b.high} low={|b: &Bar| b.low} close={|b: &Bar| b.close} volume={|b: &Bar| b.volume} class="h-72" />
    }
}

examples.title: Sideways market
examples.description: No trend: colours alternate and small bodies with long wicks appear.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn choppy() {
    let data = use_signal(bars(80, 2, 0.));
    rsx! {
        <HeikinAshi data={data} x={|b: &Bar| b.time} open={|b: &Bar| b.open} high={|b: &Bar| b.high} low={|b: &Bar| b.low} close={|b: &Bar| b.close} class="h-72" />
    }
}

examples.title: OHLC bars
examples.description: OHLC bars with custom colours, no volume.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn ohlc() {
    let data = use_signal(bars(60, 3, -0.06));
    rsx! {
        <HeikinAshi data={data} x={|b: &Bar| b.time} open={|b: &Bar| b.open} high={|b: &Bar| b.high} low={|b: &Bar| b.low} close={|b: &Bar| b.close} candle_style={CandleStyle::OhlcBars} up={rgb(0x1e66f5)} down={rgb(0xfe640b)} class="h-72" />
    }
}
